title: Process System Key User I4H
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
We are looking for a Digitalization & IT specialist to join our team at the Hosakote Plant within International Manufacturing. In this role, you connect our plant's business experts with the teams behind Volvo's D&IT solutions, making sure every system truly supports how the plant works. You report to the IM Hosakote Plant Digitalization & IT Lead and become part of a high-performing team driving the digitalization agenda for the 4th Industrial Hub Program, I4H.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* You advise stakeholders on their needs and explain how MTM-NG solutions address them, working closely with MTM-NG solution experts to identify gaps and agree on the required evolution of the platform.
* You take part in local validation setups and new releases, and you engage with factory users to understand their operational context and expectations.
* You follow up on how solutions are actually used and whether business processes are respected, and you help stakeholders build a roadmap of digital transformation projects that deliver value at every step.
* Working alongside business representatives, UI/UX experts, and architects, you make transformations as seamless as possible, maintain strong relationships across all stakeholders, and promote digital enablers and partnerships that maximize value creation.

**Who Are You**

* You bring a solid understanding of the manufacturing domain and grasp Volvo's business processes quickly.
* You can describe these processes clearly, weigh alternatives, and explain their pros and cons.
* You connect process requirements with the capabilities of MTM-NG solutions, and you approach challenges with a rigorous, analytical mindset.
* Knowledge of SAP and experience mapping business processes in material management, warehouse management, or production planning is an advantage, as is experience with lean or agile ways of working.
* You collaborate easily across units, bring a global mindset, and balance clear strategic direction with sound operational decisions.

**What's In It For You**

* Be part of a high-performing Digitalization & IT team shaping the 4th Industrial Hub Program
* Work on real manufacturing challenges with direct business impact
* Collaborate with experts across architecture, UX, and business functions
* Grow your skills in digital transformation within a global manufacturing environment

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
  
  
**Who We Are And What We Believe In**
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
  
  
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
**Volvo Group**
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
  
  
**Trucks Technology & Industrial Division**
hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.
  
  
Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.
